Job Posting: 179040 - Position: S26 Data Developer Co-op 179040 Co-op Work Term Posted: 2026 - Summer App Deadline Application Method: Posting Goes Live: Job Posting Status: 03/18/2026 09:00 AM Through UBC Science Co-op 03/11/2026 10:31 AM Approved ORGANIZATION INFORMATION Organization Address Line 1 City Postal Code / Zip Code Province / State Country Vancouver Fraser Port Authority 100 The Pointe, 999 Canada Place Vancouver V6C 3T4 BC Canada JOB POSTING INFORMATION Placement Term <b> Job Title <b> Position Type Job Location Country Duration Work Mode Salary Currency Salary Job Description 2026 - Summer S26 Data Developer Co-op 179040 Co-op Position Vancouver, BC Canada 8 months Hybrid CAD 25.0 per hour for 37.5 Major List Join us in enabling trade through Canada's largest port Join an organization that plays a critical role in Canada's economy. At the Vancouver Fraser Port Authority ("port authority"), we focus on doing the incredible work it takes to become the world's most sustainable port. The Vancouver Fraser Port Authority is responsible for the stewardship of the Port of Vancouver, Canada's largest and most diversified port. Our mandate as a Canada Port Authority, as set out by the Canada Marine Act, is to enable Canada's trade objectives, ensuring goods are moved safely and responsibly through the Port of Vancouver. That means providing infrastructure and ensuring the safe and efficient movement of marine traffic and cargo within the port. It also means we carry out reviews of proposed activities and developments on federal port lands and waters to determine whether a project can go ahead without impacts to the environment and community that cannot be mitigated. We are committed to diversity, inclusion, and sustainability. We believe in creating a workplace that reflects the richness of our community and empowers all employees to reach their full potential. What you will do: The successful candidate will support the port authority Data Infrastructure team as a data developer coop, contributing to data product delivery, business intelligence (BI) development, and data stewardship initiatives, including the implementation of data quality rules and standards across enterprise datasets. This role will also include the following duties, as required: • Contributing to the design, development and enhancement of data pipelines (ETL/ELT) and BI assets (reports, dashboards, and semantic models) that support enterprise data products and analytical use cases. • Supporting data governance and stewardship activities, including maintaining data models, data catalogues, business glossaries, as well as implementing and monitoring data quality rules in collaboration with data product owners. • Developing an end-to-end understanding of the data lifecycle, from source systems through transformation to consumption, and contributing to reliable, well-governed datasets used across business units. • Working with data engineers, BI developers, and business stakeholders to translate analytical and operational requirements into implementable data products, datasets, and reporting solutions, in alignment with data infrastructure strategy and Information Services (IS) security and privacy policies. • Assisting senior data team members in evaluating and implementing new tools or approaches through proofs of concept or minimum viable products (MVPs), with a focus on scalability and operational supportability, as appropriate. Performing other assigned duties as required. • What we offer: We offer a robust total rewards package including: • Market-competitive hourly wage rate at $25.00 per hour • Flexible remote work program • Learning, development, and advancement opportunities • Onsite gym with towel service in a national landmark in the heart of Vancouver's waterfront Friendly, unique, and respectful workplace • Location: Vancouver, Canada. Job type: Bargaining unit, student, hybrid. Pay rate: $25.00 per hour. Duration of term: Preferred work term would begin May 2026 for an 8-month work term. Regular daytime working hours: Monday to Friday, 37.5 hours per week. Working environment: Normal office conditions primarily during regular daytime working hours. The successful candidate will have the option of working remotely from home two days a week. Access to coopet connection and an appropriate, private environment is required. This is Canadian-based employment, and all employees are expected to maintain legal eligibility to work in Canada. Applicants advancing in the hiring process may be subject to technical assignments, psychometric assessments, and/or background checks, including but not limited to criminal record, credit, and/or reference checks. At the Vancouver Fraser Port Authority, we are dedicated to employment equity and a workplace reflective of the diversity of our port community. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates including women, persons with disabilities, Indigenous peoples, and members of visible minorities. Reasonable accommodation can be provided in the selection process and while working with the port authority. If you require assistance with applying to our openings or are seeking accommodations to apply in an alternative format, please contact us at careers@portvancouver.com. We are committed to supporting your needs and will do our best to provide the necessary assistance. Job Requirements What you bring: • You will be a full-time student enrolled in a post-secondary institution having completed one prior work term with preference in a mid-to-large corporate enterprise environment. • Preference will be provided to candidates pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related quantitative discipline, typically in their third year or later. • You will have proficiency with Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). • You will be a highly motivated individual with the ability to work both independently and in a team environment. • You will have excellent verbal and written communication skills and an ability to communicate tactfully and effectively with all contacts. • You will have hands-on academic or practical experience working with relational databases, analytical data stores, or data lakes, including basic data modeling concepts. • You will possess an intermediate understanding of SQL, Azure cloud and Power BI. • You will have an understanding of data security principles, efficiency, quality, and governance along with the ability to create and maintain clear technical and architectural documentation. The following will be considered as an asset: • Interest in data quality, data governance and stewardship practices, including validating data, identifying anomalies, and improving trust in analytical datasets (through coursework, projects, or prior work terms). • Cloud architecture/developer certifications (Azure). • Experience with AI/ML-enabled data management, data lakes, big data, real-time or near real-time analytics and IoT integration projects.
